report.title: Focus time — {{project}}
report.empty: No focus history yet for this project's sessions
report.concurrencyTitle: Effort time ÷ wall-clock time — how many sessions' worth of work happened per hour on average. 1.00x means no overlap. The 'while active' figure divides by only the time at least one session was actually active, so open-but-idle stretches (sessions left running while you were away) don't dilute it.
report.activeConcurrencyTitle: Effort time ÷ active wall-clock time — how parallel the work was while at least one session was actually active. 1.00x means work never overlapped. The 'across open sessions' figure divides by total open-session time instead, so open-but-idle stretches dilute it.
report.idleExcludedSub: excluded from total active agent time
report.graceNote: Gaps longer than {{grace}} with no activity aren't counted as agent time
report.windowScopedNote: Stats reflect the visible {{hours}}h window, not the full day
report.inferredNote: No focus was declared — attributed automatically from this session's activity
